Food: Edible prepared food dishes, sides and desserts including steak/porterhouse, parma, fish, crumble. Includes historical café food. Excludes drinks, raw stock packs and uncertain modifiers.
Beer: Fermented malt beverages, including cans and tap beer. Excludes porterhouse steak, wine, spirits and nonalcoholic coffee.
Wine: Wine including glass/bottle/carafe. Excludes beer and mixed cocktails.
Spirits: Distilled spirits/liqueurs served as such. Excludes cocktails and food.
Cocktails: Named mixed drinks, e.g. Margarita and Espresso Martini. Excludes plain coffee and spirits sold alone.
Non-Alcoholic: Coffee, tea, juice, soft drinks and other nonalcoholic drinks, including historical café drinks. Excludes milk or shots explicitly acting as menu modifiers.
Ingredients: Stock ingredients or bulk food packs used in preparation, e.g. raw beef, poultry, cheese, cream. Excludes identified prepared sale dishes; uncertain preparation recipes should abstain.
Modifiers: Menu additions/substitutions, e.g. Extra Shot or Oat milk added to a drink. Excludes a whole independently sold beverage or inventory milk.
Merchandise: Nonfood branded goods, e.g. tea towels, tote bags, shirts. Excludes all food/drinks.
Unclassified: Insufficient, conflicting or ambiguous evidence; no category criteria fit. Prefer abstention to guessing.
